title: Soft key ref_count is not thread-safe (non-atomic increment)
description:
In wp11_backend_soft.c lines 195-220, wp11_soft_key_ref() and wp11_soft_key_free() increment/decrement key->ref_count with plain integer operations. If two threads hold a reference to the same key object and one calls ref() while the other calls free() concurrently, the read-modify-write on ref_count is a data race. On a decrement to zero, the key is freed; a concurrent ref() may then touch freed memory.

Per PKCS#11 spec, simultaneous calls from different threads on the same session are undefined, but the same key object can appear across sessions. Needs analysis to determine if cross-session sharing is possible before deciding fix vs. documentation. Create research sub-task.
